Shaik Rusum Mohammad Rasool

Hyderabad, India | +91 8465848116 | rasool84658@gmail.com | GitHub | LinkedIn | Portfolio

SUMMARY

Senior Full-Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience designing and building scalable SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud-native solutions using NestJS, Node.js, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, AWS, and Azure.

Specialized in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, document processing pipelines, workflow automation, payment integrations, and AI-powered applications. Proven experience delivering high-volume production systems handling file processing, PDF generation, invoice automation, reporting, secure authentication, and cloud infrastructure.

Strong expertise in system design, microservices, asynchronous processing, caching strategies, API architecture, and performance optimization.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python Frontend: React.js, Next.js, Redux, Vue 3, React Native, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS

Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, BullMQ, Redis, Kafka, FastAPI Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft SQL Server

Cloud & DevOps: AWS Lambda, S3, SES, EC2, SQS, RDS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager Cloud & DevOps: Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure AI Search, Blob Storage, Event Grid, Azure Files, Azure Cache for Redis, Virtual Networks Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Cloudflare, Firebase, Coolify AI & Automation: OpenAI API, Azure AI Search, TensorFlow.js Document & Media Processing: PDF Generation, PDF Encryption, PDF Merging, OCR Workflows, DOCX Processing, Playwright, Puppeteer, Sharp Image Processing Tools: Git, GitHub, Jira, Postman, VS Code, Cursor

INTEGRATIONS

Experienced in integrating enterprise-grade third-party platforms across healthcare, communications, payments, and email services to build secure, scalable, and automated business workflows.

Healthcare: Epic EHR, Oracle Cerner ● Communication: RingCentral ● Payments: Stripe, Razorpay ● Email & Productivity: Gmail API, Microsoft 365 (Office 365), SMTP

EXPERIENCE

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER Max Trans Systems

July 2025 – Present Hyderabad

Technologies: NestJS, TypeScript, Redis, BullMQ, Azure, MSSQL, MySQL, Puppeteer, Playwright, PDF Processing, Docker

Led migration of legacy Node.js services into scalable NestJS-based modular architecture. • Designed event-driven workflows using Redis and BullMQ for report generation, invoice processing, email automation, and large file processing.

• Implemented distributed caching and rate-limiting strategies, reducing database load by 30%. • Developed bulk document processing pipelines handling thousands of records and files with high reliability.

Built secure PDF generation, encryption, watermarking, merging, and document transformation services. • Designed invoice generation and automated reporting systems used by enterprise customers. • Developed email delivery infrastructure with template management, tracking, and notification workflows. • Implemented Azure Storage, Blob Storage, File Share integrations, and large-scale document management systems.

Built workflow builders and dynamic page-builder functionality using Puck Editor and Rich Text Editor integrations.

Optimized API performance, reducing frontend network calls by 35%. • Developed asynchronous job queues for CPU-intensive document processing tasks.

FULL-STACK ENGINEER Nexg Works

April 2025 – June 2025 Hyderabad

Technologies: NestJS, FastAPI, OpenAI, Qdrant, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS

Designed enterprise-grade authentication systems with JWT, 2FA, CSP policies, bot protection, IP tracking, and security monitoring.

Built AI-powered document intelligence platform using RAG architecture, FastAPI, OpenAI, and vector databases.

Automated deployment pipelines and infrastructure provisioning. • Developed cloud-native APIs and integrations for third-party service

SOFTWARE DEVELOPER August 2023 – March 2025 Hyderabad

Aadvi Tech Solution

Technologies: React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, MSSQL, AWS

Delivered multiple production applications using React, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. • Built real-time features using WebSockets and event-driven architecture. • Improved application performance by implementing state management, lazy loading, and caching techniques. • Optimized SEO and page performance using Server-Side Rendering and Static Site Generation. • Developed secure REST APIs and authentication systems.

PROJECTS

Enterprise Real Estate Platform (Client Project) | Worked on a large-scale production platform serving real estate professionals.

Designed document generation and report automation workflows. • Implemented PDF encryption, secure document storage, and bulk file processing. • Built invoice generation and payment workflows. • Integrated Stripe payment processing and webhook event handling. • Developed dashboard analytics and reporting modules. • Created workflow management systems and dynamic page-building capabilities. • Developed email notification services and communication workflows. • Technologies: NestJS, React, Azure, Stripe, Redis, BullMQ, MSSQL, Playwright, Puppeteer

EZROI – Real Estate Investment Platform

Developed investment analysis workflows and reporting systems. • Built document generation and export services. • Implemented secure file uploads and document management. • Created dashboard modules and analytics views. • Optimized backend APIs and database performance. • Technologies: NestJS, React, Azure, SQL Server, Redis

AI-Powered Email Intelligence & Notification System

• Built serverless AWS Lambda worker that monitors email inboxes.

Uses OpenAI to summarize emails and WhatsApp Cloud API to send notifications. • Implemented idempotent processing using DynamoDB. • Automated scheduling using EventBridge. • Technologies: TypeScript, NestJS, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, OpenAI, WhatsApp Cloud API

AI Meeting Assistant

Desktop audio recording and WAV export • FastAPI backend for upload and processing • OpenAI transcription and discussion analysis • HTML Minutes of Meeting generation • SMTP-based MOM email delivery

EDUCATION

Pace Institute of Technology and Sciences Bachelor of Engineering (Computer Science), CGPA: 7.2 / 10

M.N.M Junior College Intermediate, CGPA: 8.0 / 10

2019 – 2023

2017 – 2019
